issues_state_unconfirmed_reconnecting: Luma is reconnecting. Below is the last confirmed state.
issues_state_unconfirmed_loading: Luma is loading the latest progress. Below is the last confirmed state.
issues_change_accepted_note: An accepted change doesn’t prove the issue is fixed. Luma checks the outcome separately.
issues_check_confirmed_note: The outcome matched what the change was meant to do.
issues_check_pending_note: Luma hasn’t confirmed the expected outcome yet.
issues_check_failed_help: The outcome check didn’t confirm the expected result. Review the check’s evidence and the current findings.
issues_check_running_help: Luma is reading the connected system to confirm the expected outcome.
issues_check_none_help: The outcome hasn’t been checked yet. An accepted change doesn’t prove the issue is fixed.
issues_check_unclear_help: The outcome check was inconclusive. Review its evidence before you decide what to do next.
issues_check_values_hidden: Values aren’t shown here. The evidence below shows where and when Luma read them.
issues_execution_none_awaiting_approval: The change needs approval before Luma sends it. Nothing has been sent yet.
issues_execution_none: Luma hasn’t sent a change for this issue.
issues_execution_unclear_help: Luma couldn’t tell whether the change took effect. Check the record in the connected system before trying again.
issues_execution_failed_help: The change failed. Check the attempt details and current findings before you decide what to do next.
issues_workflow_unavailable: Unavailable. Luma can’t show the current activity.
issues_phase_reconciling: Checking whether the change took effect
issues_criteria_unavailable: The expected outcome isn’t available for this attempt.
issues_resolution_human_meta: Closing doesn’t confirm that the problem was fixed. {time} · {actor}
issues_resolution_verified_body: Resolved. A fresh check confirmed the fix.
issues_resolution_human_body: Closed manually. This doesn’t confirm that the problem was fixed.
issues_resolution_verified_note: A fresh check confirmed the fix.
issues_resolution_human_note: Closing doesn’t confirm that the problem was fixed.
issues_next_steps_with_decisions: Check the attempt and evidence, then follow the current recommendation. Available decisions: {decisions}. Automatic retries aren’t available from this view.
issues_next_steps_without_decisions: Check the attempt and evidence, then follow the current recommendation. No decisions are available right now. Automatic retries aren’t available from this view.
issues_history_count: {count, plural, one {{count, number} event} other {{count, number} events}}
issues_event_change_reconciled: Change result confirmed by a new read
issues_evidence_count: {count, plural, one {{count, number} evidence record} other {{count, number} evidence records}}
issues_evidence_empty_page: This page has no evidence you can view. The history may refer to other kinds of evidence.
issues_evidence_freshness: Data freshness: {freshness}. Luma may not know when the source last changed.
issues_evidence_badge_historical: Evidence may be out of date
issues_collection_events_count: {count, plural, one {{count, number} event} other {{count, number} events}}
issues_collection_events_loaded: {count, plural, one {{count, number} event loaded} other {{count, number} events loaded}}
issues_collection_evidence_count: {count, plural, one {{count, number} evidence record} other {{count, number} evidence records}}
issues_collection_evidence_loaded: {count, plural, one {{count, number} evidence record loaded} other {{count, number} evidence records loaded}}
issues_collection_filters_loaded: Filters apply only to loaded entries. Load older entries to search further back.
issues_investigation_failed_body: The investigation couldn’t finish, so there’s no recommendation yet.
issues_investigation_unconfirmed_warning: Luma couldn’t confirm the current state. Reconnect or refresh before you act.
issues_investigation_historical_warning: These findings may be out of date. Luma needs fresh data before you act.
issues_investigation_check_updates_hint: Check whether new findings are available.
issues_investigation_check_updates_help: Checks the latest status without restarting the investigation.
issues_investigation_refresh_help: Refresh the issue to check the latest status.
issues_investigation_impact_unknown: Findings are below. Luma hasn’t established the impact.
issues_investigation_no_findings: No findings yet. The impact is unknown.
issues_exposure_note: This doesn’t confirm lost sales or oversold orders.
issues_exposure_note_before_finish: Recorded before the investigation finished. This doesn’t confirm lost sales or oversold orders.
issues_findings_and_evidence_count: {findings, plural, one {{findings, number} finding} other {{findings, number} findings}} · {evidence, plural, one {{evidence, number} evidence record} other {{evidence, number} evidence records}}
issues_findings_fact_count: {count, plural, one {{count, number} confirmed fact} other {{count, number} confirmed facts}}
issues_activity_open_body: This issue is open. Activity appears here as work progresses.
issues_impact_unknown: The impact stays unknown until the evidence supports a conclusion.
issues_impact_revenue_unknown: Revenue impact is unknown. Potential exposure doesn’t confirm lost sales or oversold orders.
issues_findings_historical: These findings describe data Luma read earlier, not current conditions.
issues_findings_unconfirmed: Luma couldn’t confirm the current state. These are the last recorded findings.
issues_findings_causes_unconfirmed: Luma hasn’t confirmed any of the possible causes.
issues_findings_potential_impact_note: Potential impact doesn’t confirm actual losses.
issues_findings_inventory_limits: This data doesn’t confirm overselling, lost revenue, or a sync failure.
issues_findings_sync_not_closed: Luma first saw this gap on {time} and waited {minutes, plural, one {{minutes, number} minute} other {{minutes, number} minutes}} for the sync between the sources. The gap is still open.
issues_findings_raised_oversell_guard: Raised without waiting for sync: the selling source shows more stock than the authority can cover.
issues_findings_no_recent_agreement: The sources haven’t agreed in the last 24 hours, so this isn’t a sale that is still syncing.
issues_findings_source_count: {count, plural, one {{count, number} source} other {{count, number} sources}}
issues_findings_sources_summary: {count, plural, one {{count, number} evidence record} other {{count, number} evidence records}} · Data freshness: {freshness}. Luma may not know when the source last changed.
issues_notice_unconfirmed_body: These are the last confirmed findings. Reconnect or refresh before you choose a fix.
issues_notice_stale_body: Luma doesn’t know the current conditions. It needs fresh data before you choose a fix.
issues_notice_pending_body: Luma detected this issue and is investigating. Findings and next steps appear when it finishes.
issues_notice_failed_body: There’s no recommendation yet. Refresh to check whether a new investigation finished.
issues_notice_insufficient_body: Linked records, the leading system, or the data Luma read don’t support a firm conclusion yet.
issues_recommendation_unconfirmed: Recommendations appear when Luma confirms the current investigation.
issues_recommendation_historical: This investigation is out of date. Its recommendations may no longer apply.
issues_step_expected: Expected result and how Luma checks it
issues_overview_step_reread_inventory: Check current stock in both systems.
issues_overview_step_manual_inventory_re: If the difference remains, ask someone with permission to correct stock to review it.
issues_overview_step_review_mapping_auth: Confirm the linked products, units, and which system leads for stock before you choose a fix.
issues_overview_summary_excess: Available to sell is {quantity} {unit} above the stock in the leading system.
issues_overview_no_automatic_fix: Luma can’t fix or retry this automatically.
issues_overview_unconfirmed: Reconnect or refresh to confirm the next action.
issues_overview_historical: These findings may be out of date. Check the current data before you choose a fix.
issues_overview_pending: Wait for the investigation to finish before you choose a fix.
issues_details_copy_failed: Luma couldn’t copy the ID. Select it to copy it yourself.
issues_review_no_undo_body: This proposal doesn’t include a way to undo the change. Don’t assume it can be reversed.
issues_review_evidence_recorded: The evidence used for this decision is listed below.
issues_review_evidence_refreshed: Luma keeps the evidence current while you review.
issues_review_policy_stale_body: Refresh this review before you decide. The earlier check no longer allows Luma to send the change.
issues_review_policy_approval_body: Someone with approval permission must approve this change.
issues_review_policy_missing_body: Luma can’t send this change until the approval rules are checked.
issues_review_policy_allowed_body: Luma sends the change without approval and checks the outcome separately.
issues_review_unavailable_body: Luma can’t send this change through the connection right now.
issues_review_outdated_body: The investigation changed. Wait for an updated proposal.
issues_review_approved_body: The approval is recorded. Luma shows sending the change and checking its outcome separately.
issues_review_none_closed: This issue is closed. There’s no change to review.
issues_review_none_escalate: Follow the recommended steps, or escalate this issue for someone else to review.
issues_review_none_investigation: See the investigation for the recommended next step.
issues_review_refresh_note: Luma checks current conditions before it sends an approved change. If the change needs to be different, Luma asks you to review it again.
issues_review_workflow_unavailable_body: Luma can’t show whether the change was sent. Refresh to check the current progress.
issues_review_decision_note: A decision alone doesn’t fix the issue. Luma confirms the outcome with a fresh check.
issues_review_progress_unavailable: Luma can’t show the change and outcome check right now.
issues_review_decisions_none: You can’t make a decision on this issue right now.
issues_review_escalate_help: A reason is required. Escalating marks this issue for further review and records your reason. It doesn’t change anything in your systems.
issues_review_decision_help: Luma saves your reason with the decision.
issues_observe_only_proposal: Would run when writes are enabled. Luma keeps this proposal and its evidence, but makes no provider changes.
issues_close_description: Close this issue without a verified fix. It will leave open views and be recorded as Closed manually.
issues_close_help: Explain why no further work is needed, up to 1,000 characters. Pending proposals will be blocked. New evidence of the same problem can create a new issue.
issues_close_running_title: Work may still be in progress
issues_close_running_body: Closing blocks new changes for this issue. It cannot cancel a change already sent or undo its effects. Running workflows may finish their current work and outcome checks; an uncertain change can still be reconciled.
issues_close_running_confirm: I understand that work already in progress may continue.
issues_summary_quantity_generic: Order line quantities differ between systems.
